verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party versioning, review, or rollback of automations such as scheduled rollouts or CLI and CI/CD pipelines. Prompt versioning (statsig-docs-44) covers AI prompts, not automations. The emergency kill switch turns off a feature, not an automation. Managing gates through the CLI in CI/CD would only give git-based versioning as a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
